# Labels that mean "do not merge this yet".
#
# Data, not code, so the list can be changed without touching workflow logic —
# and so the one place that decides what "held" means is greppable from both the
# workflow and a human's eye.
#
# This list MUST stay identical to HOLD_LABELS in the fleet tooling
# (bob/scripts/fleet_gate_labels.py), which is what ~/bin/gh-merge and
# ~/bin/mesh-merge-train read. Two copies of one rule drift silently, and a
# label that guards some merge paths but not others is worse than no label at
# all, because it gets believed and then stops being watched — that is exactly
# the incident this gate exists to close.
#
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored. Matching is case-insensitive.

hold
no-automerge
do-not-merge
wip
blocked
needs-review
